principle: As n grows, preserve the local spatial regime (thermodynamic random-geometric-graph scaling) instead of packing more points into a fixed-size pattern. L = sqrt(n / density) is the side of the square window of area n / density used by every geometry.

clustered_D3_v2.definition: Window [0, L] x [0, L]. Draw 4 hotspot centres uniform in the window; then round(0.5 n) background points uniform in the window; then the remaining points assigned round-robin to the hotspots, each Gaussian around its centre with sigma = s * L, redrawn (same rng stream) until it falls inside the window (finite-window process).
clustered_D3_v2.selection_rule: Among ladder values passing gates_v1 G1, G2, G3 and requirements R1, R2: choose the one with the highest minimum (over primary cells) G2 median clustering ratio (most clustered while scale-stable). If none passes, report; no further ladder values are added.
clustered_D3_v2.naming: Gaussian hotspot-plus-background model (Thomas-process-inspired); not a Thomas point process

bottleneck_dumbbell_v2.definition: Domain = left square [0, a] x [0, a] + corridor [a, a + l] x [a/2 - w/2, a/2 + w/2] + right square [a + l, 2a + l] x [0, a], with a = sqrt((n / density - w * l) / 2), so total area = n / density. Points uniform over the domain at intensity = density: round(n * w * l / A) corridor points, the rest split equally between the squares (left gets the extra one). Draw order: left square, corridor, right square.
bottleneck_dumbbell_v2.fallback: If it fails any of gates_v1 G1, requirements R1, R2, R3: cluster_bridge leaves the balanced primary factorial and becomes a separate bottleneck stress-test study; the dumbbell is not tweaked.
bottleneck_dumbbell_v2.replaces: cluster_bridge in the primary factorial if it passes (the v1 cluster_bridge generator is kept, unchanged, for the stress-test fallback and regression)
bottleneck_dumbbell_v2.parameter_naming_note: generator parameters are named neck_width / neck_length (the corridor geometry already uses corridor_width); values unchanged from the locked w = 1.0, l = 3.0
